summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Sylvan Union School District to issue up to $70 million in general obligation bonds, repaid through property taxes, to repair and upgrade elementary and middle school facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes a $70 million school bond funded by property-owner taxes.
tax.quote: Voters in northeast Modesto’s Sylvan Union School District will weigh Measure N, a $70 million bond costing property owners $25 annually for every $100,000 of assessed value.

schools.text: A Yes vote authorizes borrowing to fund improvements in Sylvan Union School District schools.
schools.quote: Voters in northeast Modesto’s Sylvan Union School District will weigh Measure N, a $70 million bond costing property owners $25 annually for every $100,000 of assessed value.

tax.text: A No vote does not authorize the $70 million school bond or its associated property-owner taxes.
